content:
sarah: Observed a slow memory hump on long streaming sessions with tool loops. Starts growing after ~15k tokens and doesn't fully reclaim. Repro on staging with small client load.

jay: Ugh. saw something similar last week but it hit a different model shard. Any heap profiles?

sarah: Uploaded heap diff from pprof: top shows large retention in allocation site 'kv_slot_coalesce' and 'page_reuse_write'. Attaching snippet:
```
heap profile: 12.4MB live (after gc)
  4.9MB  39.5%  kv_slot_coalesce
  3.7MB  29.8%  page_reuse_write
  1.1MB   8.9%  streaming_buffer_append
```

anand: hmm, coalescer shouldn't hold refs after eviction. Could be a slow background refcount drop or a timer keeping pages pinned.

mike: Can someone paste the repro command? I can run with perf and memwatch.

sarah: repro: `./run_stream_test --model=m-4x --long-context --tool-loop=3 --clients=2 --messages=1200`
We run for ~20 minutes to trigger the hump.

jay: I ran that once. Also noticed increased number of slab allocations around the same time: `tcmalloc: small object free list length spike`.

anand: Possible sequence: repeated KV writes -> slot coalescer merges pages -> coalescer appends to reuse list but doesn't zero old pointers -> GC can't collect because reuse list still references page objects.

sarah: Here's a log around the jump:
```
[00:15:11] session=abc write_kv page=0x7f9a6a alloc=2048
[00:15:12] coalesce queued page=0x7f9a6a -> reuse_list len=1
[00:15:12] gc: start
[00:15:12] gc: end retained=1
[00:15:12] reuse_list trim attempted=0
```

mike: If reuse_list trim attempted=0 that's suspicious. There should be a trim call every GC. Maybe a regression in the conditional around sequence numbers.

anand: I inspected the commit in last rollout: cc9e4b7 changed coalescer to avoid extra memcpy. It also added an optimization gated by `fast_coalesce=true`. Could be we accidentally skip a nulling pass.

sarah: Reverted `fast_coalesce` flag locally and memory returned to normal in a short run.

jay: Nice. So it's likely the fast path not clearing ownership metadata. Any failing unit tests?

anand: No tests cover long streaming retention. We should add an e2e that hits coalescer path repeatedly and asserts reuse_list drains after GC.

mike: I'll run perf to see if it's a refcount leak or just stale pointers. Running now on staging.

infra-bot: deploy job #587 started: staging/eng-runtime@cc9e4b7 -> roll back candidate sarah/repro-fix. ETA 45s. :gear:

sarah: Quick workaround: set `KV_REUSE_MAX_AGE_MS=5000` to force earlier trim. Works for customers who want a quick mitigation.

jay: Good short-term. Long-term we should fix coalescer clearing logic and add a fuzz style test to stress reuse list churn.

anand: Proposed patch: ensure coalescer always calls `zero_ownership_meta(page)` before pushing to reuse_list. Also add a metric `reuse_list_len` and emit on GC.

mike: After rollback + workaround, runs stable for 1 hour and memory plateaued at expected baseline. I'll collect a final pprof and send to the thread.

sarah: Thanks. I'll open an RFC and link the rollback & patch PR. We should also notify support for customers on long-tool loops.

anand: Assigning to @jay for the test and @sarah for the PR.

jay: Got it. I'll add the e2e and a unit that simulates GC timing races.

sarah: TL;DR: regression introduced by fast_coalesce optimization left pages referenced in reuse list -> prevents GC reclaim after long streaming/tool loops. Rollback and config mitigation applied. Patch + tests in progress.

mike: 👍 thanks team.
